name: Repeat a spoken instruction accurately
short_description: Repeat a spoken instruction accurately once under stated everyday conditions without assistance.
self_assessment: I can repeat a spoken instruction accurately in one repeatable attempt without help.
description: Repeat a spoken instruction accurately means carrying out this capability under ordinary, stated conditions without another person completing any part. Practice focuses on the observable result, the threshold in the self-assessment, and repeatability across more than one occasion. The capability includes selecting an appropriate approach, completing the action, and checking the outcome. It excludes brand-specific steps, credentials, unrelated habits, and one-off achievements.
examples: Repeat a spoken instruction accurately in a fresh real-life scenario.

builds_on.note: Follow a written instruction helps develop repeat a spoken instruction accurately but is not indispensable.
Read a short notice accurately helps develop repeat a spoken instruction accurately but is not indispensable.
